Chapter 6561: Primal Yin Desire Skybreaker Armament

Chapter 6561: Primal Yin Desire Skybreaker Armament

The stone hammer immobilized everything, rendering them helpless before its swing.

However, the overlord that had just broken through his bottleneck nullified this effect.

“Immortal’s Fall.” He mustered his yin power and summoned a lotus.

The hammer was crafted by Xian Chengtian himself and helped him sweep through Three Immortals. However, the ghost’s yin lotus included the affinities nearby and blossomed around him to stop the smash.

“Bam!” Shockwaves shattered stars.

The continuous smashes sent the ghost flying, albeit unharmed despite not using a defensive treasure.

“Brother, impressive but not enough to kill me.” He said.

Xian Chengtian’s expression changed since this guy spoke so domineeringly - a stark contrast from the past.

“We’ll see how many moves you can handle.” Chengtian stepped forward again with the hammer.

The world seemed to be backing off from his steps, unable to endure his presence.

The ghost became qualified to seek the immortal stage and gained the confidence to challenge Xian Chengtian. However, the latter was not considered the strongest beneath the immortal stage for no reason.

Moreover, he had worked with Chengtian long enough to know how frightening he was in both cultivation and wrath. Alas, he had enough motivation to fight today.

“Zzz...” The yin had been taken out of the areas. Night would be no more henceforth, leaving only the yang affinity.

This yin accumulation wrapped around the ghost as an impenetrable armor. It flowed as if alive.

“Clank!” He summoned a long axe capable of sucking souls oout of the living.

“Primal Yin Desire Skybreaker Armament.” A primal ancestor who had seen it before became frightened.

The ghost spent his life crafting this set, versed in both offense and defense and inferior to nothing of the same grade. The set included Primal Yin Desire Armor and Skybreaker Decapitator.

A single strand from his yin affinity could cut a world into two halves. It had the signature softness and flexibility while maintaining a deadly sharpness.

“Bam!” He met Chengtian’s smash and only staggered backward with the help of his armament.

“Ghost Slay!” He gathered power into his hatchet and went on the offensive.

Space withered and death triumphed over life. He seemed to be the judge deciding that all lives should cease and be destroyed.

Chengtian parried with his hammer. The impact devastated the battlefield. This time around, Chengtian staggered backward.

“Looks like you haven’t exercised in a long time and are out of practice.” The ghost said, humiliating Chengtian. This was a way to vent all he had to endure in the past.

“I see, you have improved instead after absorbing the power of the ancient immortals.” Chengtian said: “But to defeat me with these two weapons? Utterly ridiculous.”

“Let’s keep going then.” The ghost sneered.
